name: downward facing dog adho mukha svanasana
description: An inverted V shape that stretches the back of the legs and spine while loading the shoulders. A classic yoga staple.
instructions: Start on hands and knees with hands slightly ahead of shoulders.
Tuck your toes and lift your hips up and back.
Straighten your legs as far as comfortable and press your chest toward your thighs.
Spread your fingers and push the floor away.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing slowly.
